BiblicalUsage: This Aramaic word is strength, might, and an army, and it gathers around the kings of Babylon. The herald cries mightily to the peoples and nations, the most mighty men of the army bind the three friends, Nebuchadnezzar learns that God does His will in the army of heaven, and Belshazzar cries aloud to bring in the wise men of his kingdom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe there are two armies in Daniel and only one of them rules. The army of Babylon binds and burns, but the army of heaven does God's will, and no one can stay His hand.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace; Nebuchadnezzar's Humbling; Belshazzar's Handwriting on the Wall
